# Separate native portrait mobile qualification — preparation only

The proposed [patch](mobile-guidance.patch) changes only the private mobile-image guidance: brand type across app-owned labels; complete opaque raw backgrounds unless transparency is requested; inspection and honest reporting of actual pixel size using supported controls. Platform-owned status typography remains platform appropriate. Canonical sources have not been edited; parent owns any application after the original aggregation closes.

Original F09 remains failed. Its exact1179×2556 requirement and observed typography/background defects are preserved per output. This fixture does not pool, regrade or replace those results. Exact-resolution generation remains unqualified; the evidence does not prove every numeric resolution impossible.

The new request replaces only the original numeric-size sentence with native portrait output and actual dimension reporting. Original common facts, five-dimension rubric/floor3, baseline body, root and other private references, paired order, authority, two real images and maximum two calls remain. The candidate snapshot includes only the proposed mobile patch. One explicit check verifies portrait pixels and truthful reported dimensions. `qualification.json` makes typography/opacity interpretation visible without changing the original records.

The matching CLI exposes no numeric image size parameter; matching source sends auto sizing. This qualification asks for a portrait composition and measures the delivered pixels. It neither promises an exact native resolution nor invents a tool option. Its purpose is to qualify mandatory image-only mobile behavior through the available interface, with image quality decided by another reviewer from actual primary files and full native/transitive tool evidence.

The small launcher reuses `captureTrial`, `runPairs` and the unchanged native recorder. Six attempts are fixed: three paired repetitions, one turn each, two image calls maximum, no expansion or retry. All five model/reasoning/sandbox/approval/reviewer controls and the executable are bound and verified; no settings override is applied. The launcher requires parent approval, a fresh fixed `/tmp/qs-frontend-mobile-native-qualification-20260926` output and an exclusive persistent `run-claim.json`. It waits for both active captures and uses existing identity-scoped interruption. Missing artifacts/protocol errors remain failures or unverified evidence, never automatic quality passes.

Preparation commands (no model requests):

```sh
node --test tests/fixtures/frontend-mobile-repair/preparation.test.mjs
node tests/fixtures/frontend-mobile-repair/run.mjs verify
```

Parent only after reviewing source, criteria and actual-run authority:

```sh
node tests/fixtures/frontend-mobile-repair/run.mjs run --parent-approved
```

Freeze binds source snapshots, proposed patch, launcher/tests/criteria, original plan and dependencies, exact interface diagnosis, selected executable and inherited controls. The preparation author must not review the resulting images. Opaque exports retain the existing partial-blinding limits: exact guidance bodies are redacted, but names or partial instruction chunks can reveal identity. No model/image generation, canonical edit, package installation, native-home mutation or actual trial has occurred during preparation.
